
# Phoenix Gravity Water Filters

> Phoenix Gravity makes NSF-certified, gravity-fed water filtration systems built from AISI 304 stainless steel. Using coconut-shell activated carbon (and an optional POSTreat fluoride/arsenic media), the systems remove up to 99.9% of chlorine, PFAS/PFOA/PFOS, heavy metals, and other tested contaminants from tap water without electricity or plumbing. Products ship within the US only. Every complete system includes a 100-day money-back guarantee and a 10-year warranty on the stainless steel housing.

Phoenix Gravity Water Filters is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand (Shopify) selling one flagship gravity water filtration system plus replacement filters, add-on media, and accessories. The company has over 50 years of manufacturing experience and publishes independent third-party lab reports (PFOA/PFOS, heavy metals, pharmaceuticals/VOCs) alongside NSF/ANSI 42 and NSF/ANSI 372 certifications.

## Products

- [Complete Gravity Water Filter System](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/gravity-water-filter): Flagship stainless steel gravity filtration system, multiple sizes and filter/stand configurations.
- [Phoenix Gravity Water Filter System 0.26 Gallon](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/phoenix-gravity-water-filter-system-0-26-gallon): Compact/personal-size version of the system.
- [Carbon Filter Element](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/carbon-filter-element): Replacement activated coconut-carbon filter elements (primary filtration media).
- [POSTreat Steel Fluoride & Arsenic Reduction Filter Elements](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/fluoride-reduction-elements): Add-on stainless steel media housing that removes 95%+ of fluoride and arsenic.
- [POSTreat FluoRid Refill Media](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/fluoride-refill-media): Replacement media refill for the POSTreat fluoride/arsenic filter.
- [Stainless Steel Spigot](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/stainless-steel-spigot): Standard replacement spigot.
- [Stainless Steel Spigot With Water Level Gauge](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/7-inch-stainless-steel-vision-spigot): Upgraded spigot with a built-in water level indicator.
- [Premium Wooden Stand](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/wooden-stand-for-gravity-water-filter-system): Teak wood stand accessory for the filter system.
- [Stainless Steel Stand](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/stainless-steel-stand): Stainless steel stand accessory for the filter system.
- [Airlock Vent Clips](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/airlock-clip): Replacement vent clip accessory.
- [Spare Knob](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/knob): Replacement lid knob.
- [Spare Hole Blockers / Plugs](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/pp-plug): Replacement hole blocker plugs.
- [Washer and Nut Spare Parts](https://phoenixwaterfilters.com/products/washer-and-nut): Replacement washers and wing nuts for filter elements.
